title: GET /models
description: The models downloaded on this Mac, as the engine view's picker lists them. Every one is complete; a download in progress is not listed.

memory_budget_bytes.description: the GPU memory the engine may hold, which `fits` is planned against; 0 while no model has been loaded yet (every `fits` is then "unknown")

name.description: what POST /model takes for it: "qwen3.5-4b:4bit", or the model's folder when no name finds it

title.description: the catalog's name for it, "Qwen3.5-4B"; absent for a model Kapitsa does not know

variant.description: its precision or file format: "4bit", "gguf Q4_K_M"

includes.description: what the folder holds beside the weights: "MTP head", "DFlash2 drafter"

fits.description: one conversation at the default context fits within the budget beside the model and its drafter (fits), only without the drafter, so slower (no_drafter), or not even that (too_big); unknown: its files could not be planned

current.description: the model this instance serves now
